meta_description: Security architecture you can evidence — for humans, machines and models.

blocks.x: Security architecture you can evidence — for humans, machines and models.

Achala Sentinel unifies our security delivery: zero-trust enforcement points (identity, posture, segmentation, workload identity), detection-as-code with ATT&CK coverage, cloud posture guardrails, and the AI-specific layer — prompt-injection defense, agent containment, shadow-AI discovery and model security cards.

Sentinel is engineered for the evidence economy: controls mapped across SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST 800-207, DORA and AI regimes, tested continuously, exported to auditors. Boards get measured trust reduction, not adjectives.

Sentinel assumes breach and designs for audit: purple-team validation of segmentation, restore-tested backups, AI red-team suites with findings-to-fix tracking. The platform's own controls are SOC 2 Type II audited and ISO 27001 certified.

items: every artifact the platform produces doubles as audit evidence — no reconstruction projects.
teams start at pattern 80% and spend their budget on the 20% that is genuinely yours.
named control owner per deployment; platform telemetry makes the owner's job inspectable.

blocks.x: Achala Sentinel typically enters an estate during the Prove phase — configured for your controls in the sandbox, hardened through Industrialize, and left running under the customer's own keys with our pods on the follow-the-sun operations rhythm.
Certified integration surface: SIEM/XDR, SPIFFE/SPIRE, OPA, IdPs/IGA, CNAPP tooling.
Primary industry deployments: Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Energy & Utilities, Public Sector & Government, Technology & SaaS, Manufacturing & Industrial.
